relationships.subject: CART(55-76)
relationships.evidence_quote: its concentration increased significantly in the CART(55-76)-treated inflamed animals, suggesting that IPI was cleaved immediately from exogenously applied CART(55-76) peptides under inflammatory conditions

key_findings: CART(55-76) is cleaved to the DPP4 inhibitor IPI in inflamed spinal cord; IPI reduces LPS-induced TNFα and IL-6 release from spinal astrocytes.
CART fragments do not bind opioid or other GPCRs; DPP4 expression in astrocytes rises with TLR4 activation.
